body.name: Conditional Poisson martingale family
body.construction: For each \(q\in\Theta(P)\), propagate \(\alpha_t(q)\), form \(\Delta_t(q)=\alpha_{t-1}(q)\{L_q(X_{t-1},X_t)-K_{\pi}\}h\), and set \(M_T(q)=\sum_{t=1}^T\Delta_t(q)\). This family enters the proved \(\ell_1\)-net and Hoeffding bound and the residual root-\(T\) maximal-inequality question.
